summary.title: Student Results Portal Threat Model
summary.description: ICS4203 Threat Modelling Lab - University Student Results Portal. Baseline architecture plus the remote-learning extension scenario, with STRIDE threats mapped from the group's completed STRIDE table.

threats.mitigation: MFA, strong password policy, suspicious login detection.
threats.title: Stolen student credentials
threats.description: Attacker steals a student's login details and impersonates them to view results/transcripts.

threats.mitigation: MFA, session management and login auditing.
threats.title: Stolen lecturer credentials
threats.description: Attacker obtains a lecturer's credentials by theft and logs in under the disguise of being a lecturer.

threats.mitigation: IP rate limiting, request throttling, traffic monitoring, DDoS protection.
threats.title: Portal flooding
threats.description: Attacker floods the portal with excessive requests, exhausting server resources.

threats.mitigation: Bot login protection, anomaly monitoring, resilient authentication services.
threats.title: Authentication flooding
threats.description: Attacker sends excessive authentication requests, exhausting identity-server resources or locking out legitimate users.

threats.mitigation: Strict RBAC, least privilege, deny-by-default authorization, server-side permission checks.
threats.title: Privilege escalation to admin
threats.description: A student or lecturer exploits weak authorization to obtain administrator privileges.

threats.mitigation: RBAC, database permissions, integrity checks, audit logs.
threats.title: Unauthorised score modification
threats.description: Attacker alters examination scores stored in the Results DB without authorisation.

threats.mitigation: Database encryption, least-privilege permissions, network restrictions, monitoring.
threats.title: Bulk Results DB exposure
threats.description: Unauthorized access to the Results DB exposes large numbers of student records.

threats.mitigation: Tamper-resistant audit logging recording user identity, action, timestamp and affected record.
threats.title: Lecturer denies mark change
threats.description: Lecturer modifies a result then denies the action; system cannot reliably prove who made the change.

threats.mitigation: HTTPS/TLS, certificate validation, secure API communication.
threats.title: In-transit data tampering
threats.description: Attacker intercepts network traffic between browser and server and alters marks/data in transit.

threats.mitigation: RBAC, encryption in transit and at rest, server-side access checks.
threats.title: Unauthorized transcript access
threats.description: Attacker accesses another student's results/transcript in an unauthorized manner.

threats.mitigation: Server-side authorization, RBAC, endpoint-level access control, least privilege.
threats.title: Student accesses lecturer functions
threats.description: Student manipulates a request to gain permission to upload or modify marks.

labelText.text: TB0 Unmanaged Device / Home Network Zone

text.text: TB0 Unmanaged Device / Home Network Zone

threats.mitigation: Full-disk encryption, MDM, remote wipe, short-lived tokens.
threats.title: Stolen laptop
threats.description: Lecturer's personal laptop is lost or stolen, exposing cached credentials/session tokens.

threats.mitigation: Enforce TLS end-to-end, discourage public Wi-Fi, VPN/ZTNA for sensitive actions.
threats.title: Insecure home network
threats.description: Traffic from a student's home Wi-Fi/mobile network may traverse an untrusted or compromised network.

threats.mitigation: MDM with data-loss prevention, disable local downloads for sensitive reports, encryption at rest.
threats.title: Unmanaged local data storage
threats.description: Marks or reports cached/downloaded to a personal laptop persist outside institutional control.

data.name: Local caching of transcripts on device

threats.mitigation: Auto session timeout, biometric/app-lock, conditional access based on device posture.
threats.title: Unauthorised family access
threats.description: A shared personal device may allow a family member to view a logged-in student's results/transcript.

labelText.text: Local caching of transcripts on device
